concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish luminous objects, which emit their own light, from non-luminous objects such as the Moon, which only reflect light.
Identify natural sources of light and artificial sources such as fire and electric lamps, including LEDs.

topics.title: Does Light Travel in a Straight Line?

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the matchbox, bent-pipe and laser activities show that light travels in a straight line.

topics.title: Light through Transparent, Translucent, and Opaque Materials

concepts.learning_objective: Classify materials as transparent, translucent or opaque by how much light passes through them.
State that a shadow forms when an object blocks light, and that a light source, an opaque object and a screen are needed to observe it.
Explain how the size and shape of a shadow change with the position of the object relative to the light source and the screen.
Describe reflection as the change in direction of light by a mirror or shiny surface.

topics.title: Images Formed in a Plane Mirror

concepts.learning_objective: State that a plane mirror image is erect, of the same size as the object and cannot be obtained on a screen.
Explain lateral inversion and its everyday uses, such as the lettering on an ambulance.
Explain how a pinhole camera forms an inverted image of an object on a screen.
Describe how plane mirrors are used in a periscope and a kaleidoscope.
